items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the everyday routine simple and comfortable for oily-feeling skin.
A lightweight mattifying gel moisturizer with niacinamide helps balance shine while adding light moisture.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is the most useful everyday step for protecting skin appearance and keeping tone even.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and evening, then apply the mattifying gel; in the morning finish with sunscreen and reapply if outdoors for long periods. At night, just cleanse and moisturize to keep things simple.
